Subject: Renewal planning — usage variance and term question

Hi Camila,

As we approach our renewal (current term ends 2027-06-30) the Crestview engineering and finance teams have been running the usage numbers. Two quick notes:

- We expect steady growth in NLU inference in H2 but Q1 usage was ~28% below our forecast due to a delayed product rollout.
- Given that, Finance is asking whether you can offer a temporary price hold for the first 6 months of the renewal or provide an offsetting credit, while we commit to a modest capacity uplift in 12 months.

Concretely, we're asking for: 1) a price hold on per-token rates for 6 months, 2) a one-time credit to make up for Q1 shortfall (we were expecting a larger commitment), and 3) an option to increase our reserved capacity by up to 30% mid-term without a re-negotiation.

We have flexibility on contract length (12–24 months) if that helps with an improved economic package. I attached a small usage extract (usage_dashboard_q1.csv) so you can see the variance.

Can we schedule a call early next week to walk through numbers? We need to present to our CFO by 2027-06-02.

Thanks,
Daniel
Head of Platform
Crestview AI

Subject: RE: FWD: Renewal planning — usage variance and term question

Camila — thanks for the context. I pulled margin and capacity impact and drafted a short amendment. Key points below and in attached PDF (proposed_amendment_4321.pdf):

Summary proposal (internal):
- Contract length: 18 months (2027-07-01 to 2028-12-31) — gives us some runway and aligns billing cycles.
- Pricing: 9% recurring discount on their committed rate vs current list if they sign the 18-month commit.
- Price hold: temporary 6-month price hold on per-token list rates for usage above baseline only (baseline = average of last 6 months). We avoid a full absolute hold to limit downside.
- One-time credit: $40,000 one-time credit applied to first invoice (non-recoupable).
- Mid-term capacity uplift: allow one mid-term reserved increase up to 30% with a pro-rated true-up and no re-negotiation; any subsequent increases will be treated as expansion and re-priced.
- Operational guardrails: require a simple change-order form and 10 business days lead time for capacity changes; any SLA changes outside the standard will need Eng review.

Rationale: 9% + $40k credit balances their ask while protecting long-term unit economics. The mid-term uplift with a pro-rated true-up addresses their flexibility need without locking in open-ended risk.

Next steps:
1) Camila — you can present this to Crestview as a commercial amendment.
2) If they accept, run a PO and sign amendment. We should log the HubSpot deal update (see link in metadata).

Attachment: proposed_amendment_4321.pdf (term summary & legal bullets)

Jordan Blake
Director, Commercial Pricing
Redwood Inference

Hi Daniel / Priya,

Thanks for the clear note and the usage extract. We reviewed internally and can offer a structured amendment aimed at balancing Crestview's near-term cashflow needs and Redwood's unit economics. High-level we propose:

- Term: 18 months (2027-07-01 — 2028-12-31).
- Recurring pricing: 9% discount on committed tier rates for the term if the amendment is signed by 2027-06-07.
- Price hold: a 6-month conditional price hold that applies to per-token list rates for usage above baseline; baseline is defined as the average usage from 2026-11 to 2027-04. This protects both sides from baseline volatility.
- One-time credit: $40,000 applied to the first invoice to offset Q1 shortfall (non-recoupable).
- Mid-term uplift: Crestview may request one reserved-capacity uplift of up to 30% during the term. The uplift will be pro-rated from the effective date and subject to a simple change-order form (10 business days lead time). Any additional increases will trigger expansion pricing.

I attached the proposed amendment and a short summary for your CFO (Crestview_Renewal_Term_Sheet_v2.pdf). If this looks acceptable, can we do a 30-minute call tomorrow (2027-05-27) to finalize and sign? Alternatively, if you confirm by email we can issue the amendment for signature within 24 hours.

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
Account Executive, Strategic Renewals
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Crestview_Renewal_Term_Sheet_v2.pdf, proposed_amendment_4321.pdf
